# Kurio NFT Marketplace

Kurio is a digital marketplace for discovering NFT collections, viewing NFT details, and exploring digital artwork.

## Main pages

- [Marketplace home](https://junglegaming.thomazot.com.br/)
- [NFT detail example](https://junglegaming.thomazot.com.br/nft/emerald-ape-000)
- [AI resource catalog](https://junglegaming.thomazot.com.br/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)
